_decision: Compact secondary text maps onto text-xs. Our scale has no step at origin's 13px, so this lands one pixel smaller — a real, accepted shrink rather than an exact match.
_scale: Values come from the approved type mapping, not from measuring the component: Tailwind's own theme.css defines --text-base 1rem/1.5rem, --text-sm 0.875rem/1.25rem, --text-xs 0.75rem/1rem, --font-weight-medium 500.
_scope: The panel header's subtitle, the one place in the rail this tier renders. D-11's line-clamp claim is on the same element and is its own spec.
